IdentityA marksman who plants their feet and makes every shot count, with exploding dice, steady nerves and grit that won't go down.

Level by Level at a Glance

What you gain and when. Full details are under Class Abilities.

LvlYou gain
1Firearm Proficiency, Quick Draw, Dead Eye, Grit
2Lightning Reload
3Dead Aim
4Called Shot
5Two-Gun Shot (Extra Attack)
6Perfect Shot
7Steady Shot
8Trick Shot
9Brace and Fire, kit improves
10Called Shot without Disadvantage
13Dead Aim improves
15+1 Dexterity
20Perfect Shot improves, Renown: Company
24Legendary Shot

Class Abilities

1st Level

Firearm Proficiency

  • Effect: Use blackpowder weapons without disadvantage.
  • Firearm damage is exploding: when a damage die shows its highest number, roll it again and add the result (see Exploding Dice in the Codex).
  • Non-Gunslingers follow the Firearms training rules in the Codex

Quick Draw

  • Effect: Drawing a loaded sidearm (pistol) doesn't use your one free object use this turn.
  • The weapon must already be loaded
  • Drawing an unloaded weapon and loading it still costs a full action

Dead Eye

  • Effect: On a turn you don't move, your first ranged attack's damage dice explode on either of their two highest numbers (see Exploding Dice in The Arneyan Codex).
  • You cannot move before or after attacking: once you attack with Dead Eye you are rooted until the end of your turn, and if you have already moved this turn you gain no benefit. Forced movement (being shoved, knocked prone and so on) does not count

Grit

  • Effect: Once per day, when you are reduced to 0 HP or below, you stay at 1 HP instead.

2nd Level

Lightning Reload

  • Effect: All blackpowder weapons reload one round faster (minimum: reload as part of an attack, once per round).
  • Combined with Quick Draw, a Gunslinger can draw, fire, and reload in a single round, ready to fire again next round

3rd Level

Dead Aim

  • Effect: If you did not move or attack last turn, your first shot this turn has Advantage and deals +1d6 damage.

4th Level

Called Shot

  • Effect: You can make Called Shots (see Combat Manoeuvres in The Arneyan Codex); from 10th level they don't take the Disadvantage.

5th Level

Two-Gun Shot

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).
  • A firearm still has to be loaded for each shot.
  • No Disadvantage when the extra shot is fired from a second loaded firearm, drawn as part of the attack, so no reload.

6th Level

Perfect Shot

  • Effect: Once per day, declare before rolling: if the shot hits, every damage die explodes once, whatever it rolled (roll it again and add the result; the new die explodes as normal).

7th Level

Steady Shot

  • Effect: While Dead Eye applies, the first attack that hits each round deals +1d6 bonus damage.
  • Stacks with Dead Aim; both bonuses are added on the same shot

8th Level

Trick Shot (Dexterity)

  • Effect: Perform an impossible-looking shot: DC determined by the GM based on difficulty, using the General Difficulty Tiers table.
  • Shoot around corners, ricochet off surfaces, disarm a target at range within 30ft
  • Pin clothing or hair to a surface, cut a rope, thread a needle
  • One attempt per round — a failed check simply misses

9th Level

Brace and Fire

  • Effect: Once per round, out of turn, stand firm against a charging creature: fire before they reach you without needing Dead Eye's no-movement requirement.
  • If the attack hits, the charging creature takes damage and must make a Fortitude save or stop the charge

13th Level

Dead Aim (Improved)

  • Effect: Dead Aim's bonus damage rises to +2d6.

15th Level

  • Dexterity Bonus: permanent +1 Dexterity

20th Level

Perfect Shot (Improved)

  • Effect: Perfect Shot can be used twice per day.

Renown: Company

  • Effect: You may found a gun company (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 2d6 shooters and an armourer join it. While you hold it, firearms supplied from it misfire on one number fewer (a Misfire of 1-2 becomes 1); a natural 1 still misfires.

24th Level

Legendary Shot

  • Effect: Once per encounter, make a single ranged attack against any target in line of sight regardless of range: no distance penalties apply, and every damage die of it explodes once, whatever it rolled, as with Perfect Shot.
  • Any creature that witnesses the shot and survives must make a Will save against your Class Save DC, or suffer disadvantage on their first attack against the Gunslinger for the remainder of the encounter

Kits: Gunslinger Traditions

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Gunslinger folder. Drag one onto your character.

Choose one Kit at character creation. Your kit defines the tradition, culture, and context that shaped your relationship with blackpowder.
